issue.title: test_ace_page_group_rejects_overlapping_checkouts leaks focus only under full-lane load
issue.description:
## Flake report

- **Test:** `tests/test_ace_testing.py::test_ace_page_group_rejects_overlapping_checkouts`
- **Repro:** `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_ace_testing.py::test_ace_page_group_rejects_overlapping_checkouts -q -p no:randomly`

Failed once in the full 3-worker `just check` lane (`AcePageGroup isolation
leak(s): focus expected ('CommitsTimeline', 'stitches-timeline'), got None`,
plus a `NoMatches: #stitches-timeline` TUI error) while the host sat at load1
30-45 over a 32-minute suite run, then passed on the same tree in a focused
rerun (part of a 21-passed focused batch in ~24s). Load-timing flake; no code
overlap with the monitor_failed_count_leak diff under verification (status
buckets only, no focus/widget structure).

Observed at HEAD `eba6b80d0` during monitored `just check` run `5gky1hb2f6rp`
(tool run `f612c7e28035a677677bc1779111476b`).

task_type_fields.evidence: Fail rate 1/2 observed: failed once in the full 3-worker lane at load1 30-45 (focus isolation leak, expected CommitsTimeline got None), passed once focused on the identical tree (~24s batch). Serial focused rerun passes; parallel full-lane run fails.
